sources.entry: SuiteCRM - The award-winning, enterprise-class open source CRM. (Source Code) AGPL-3.0 PHP

summary.one_liner: SuiteCRM is an open-source, enterprise-oriented customer relationship management (CRM) web application built on PHP, Apache/IIS, and MySQL/MariaDB/MSSQL.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes SuiteCRM 7.15.2 as a mature, stable open-source CRM with regular releases that include new features, security patches, and bug fixes. It is based on standard technologies (Apache, PHP, MySQL) and can be self-hosted on an internal network, on a public cloud provider, or on a managed hosting service. Stated requirements are PHP 8.1 to 8.4 and a web server (Apache recommended, or IIS), with MySQL or MariaDB (recommended) or MSSQL as the database. The README points to a compatibility matrix and installation guide for details. It also mentions a public demo that resets hourly, and a community forum for support. The README notes that SuiteCRM 8 is the newer major version but is not yet as feature complete.
use_cases: self-hosted CRM for a small or medium business
managing customer contacts and sales data on your own server
running a CRM on an internal network
customising an open-source CRM to fit business processes
evaluating a CRM through the online demo
how_to_run: Install a web server (Apache recommended, or IIS) with PHP 8.1 to 8.4
Set up MySQL or MariaDB (recommended) or MSSQL as the database
Consult the Compatibility Matrix and Installation Guide linked from the README
Download the SuiteCRM 7 release and run the installer in your web browser
Upgrade to the latest ESR release when available, as recommended in the README
notable: Open-source CRM under AGPLv3 with user control over their data
Built on standard LAMP-style technologies, so it runs on common hosting
Active community forum and an extensions directory
Regular releases with security patches for the SuiteCRM 7 line
Offered alongside managed hosting and support plans from SuiteCRM Ltd
caveats: The README says SuiteCRM 8 is not yet as feature complete as SuiteCRM 7, so this repository's version is the older line
Best performance and compatibility are stated for Linux-based LAMP servers; Windows is supported but less recommended
Managed hosting, support plans, and SuiteASSURED are offered by SuiteCRM Ltd, which suggests commercial options alongside the free project
keywords: manage customers on my own server
